notes.title: Phantasmata: Ruby Update
notes.content:
[i][b]Whew! [/b][/i]

There's been [b]a lot[/b] of changes, upgrades, and polishing since the Amethyst update.
[i]Scroll to the bottom for images/screenshots.[/i]
Here to catch you up is a list of all the most notable changes:
[list]
[*] New Title logo!
[*] New title screen video
[*] New NPCs & mobs

[*] 	DOG NPC added (includes barking)
        Yes, now you CAN pet the dog 

[b]Mobs:[/b]
[*] 	drunken octopus
[*] 	water elemental 
[*] 	zapp (electric monster)
[*] 	electric bride ( elemental ) 
[*] 	staff monk
[*] 	sea wraith
[*] 	new killdozer variation added 
[*] 	7 Elite Critter variations added 
         each one with their own different combat abilities 
	 some are elemental

[b] Overworld NPCs & mobs:[/b]
[*] 	Cultist
[*] 	Cultist Assassin 
[*] 	Cultist Sentinel
[*] 	Cultist Knight
[*] 	Cultist Mage 

[b]Mini-bosses:[/b]
[*] 	added '7 deadly sins' during hell section, you will go up a building and on each
	floor there will be a different sin waiting to battle you 
[*] 	envy
[*] 	lust
[*] 	greed
[*] 	sloth
[*] 	wrath
[*] 	pride 
[*] 	gluttony 

[b] Combat UI overhaul:[/b]
[*] 	majority of character visible instead of windowed face portrait 
[*] 	UI changed and updated to reduce screen clutter and showcase characters more 
[*] 	HP+MP meters updated 
[*] 	each battler adjusted to take up proper space on screen 

[b] Revamped exteriors/interiors/overworld [/b]
[*] 	Forest: completely updated, more variation in terrain, better trees, foliage, and props.
[*] 	Helll: variation in terrain, new background, better NPC distribution, 7 sins & 7 floors added to boss tower.
[*] 	Desert: new 'doodads' added to map
	 new desert outpost area added to the West desert map 
         updated East desert map
[*] 	Netverse: new NPC dialogue integrated for all NPCs 
			-cleaned up some paths 
 			-redistribution of foes 
			-added objective to turn off beacons in order to access boss battle 
[*] 	Hospital: 
		hospital interior added, includes 2 shops within 
[*] 	Lake: scripted sequence added involving a tiny bug and his kin 

[*] [b]Implementation of 'Doodads'[/b] (decoration decals/art assets for levels)
[*] 	10 foliage 
[*] 	5 desert buildings 
[*] 	3 generic 
[*] 	8 city propaganda ( some animated )
[*] 	dozens of new wall art/graffiti/billboards/posters

[*]Difficulty & combat balancing 
[*]Mini-icons added for:
 	status effects
 	items/weapons/armor 
 	description icons for overworld objects/npcs 
[*] Additional Jinx portrait/sprite added & original design updated ([i]she looks much cuter now[/i])	
[*] Colored and added mobs that had inks but no colors ( eg: aquarius and some wastelanders )
[*] Added/updated vendors across ALL maps to include new weapons/armor/items/skill pills 
[*] Elemental attacks/skills added for both player and foes 
[*] NPC dialogue updated & revamped across ALL maps 
[*] Added background lore & story to some books in the Phantasmata city library 

[*] [b]Many more battle/combat animations added & updated [/b]
additions include:

[b] Bugfixes:[/b]
[*] Fixed any hard-locks preventing the player from progressing most notably some overlay tiles that were solid that weren't supposed to be solid, blocking the path.
[*] Fixed lag in Mall area ( still getting some FPS drops, I have been testing and trying different things and I have no idea what is causing this besides 'events' ) if anyone has any ideas please drop a line on the discord!
[*] Fixed one-hit killer mob attacks along with attacks that could take out your entire squad with one move.
[*] Fixed healing that wouldn't occur at the end of chapters (you're supposed to recover your party's health each chapter) 
[*] Fixed general clipping issues with tiles in some maps 
[*] Pruned unused plugins 
[/list]

As always, please notify me of any bugs you encounter during your play at the official discord! 
Your feedback is immensely appreciated, please do not hesitate to reach out, thank you :)

notes.title: PHANTASMATA AMETHYST UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Major changes include:[/b]
[list]

[*] The ability to play through the entire main story campaign by following the quest book.

[*] Featuring all-new music by [i][b]Turingsghost[/b][/i]

[*] All-new combat HUD and battle portrait interface.

[*] Many visual updates/polishing:
- Protagonists
 - Enemies
 - Tiles/ world backgrounds
 - Combat backgrounds
 - Combat FX

[*] Complete quest log for the entire main story campaign

[*] Combat Balancing

[*] Complete mob re-distribution and balancing
 (mobs will now be in areas where they belong & enemy toughness
 will reflect the area they are in)

[*] All-new mobs!

[*] Item/weapon/armor/skill dispensers distributed across all areas

[*] New skill vendor system: you don't automatically learn skills.
   Instead, you buy 'skill pills' from vendors for your specified class using credits and 
  learn skills at your leisure for complete character customization and strategic choice.

[/list]

The development team is still hard at work and steadily churning out content and improvements that will hopefully bring us closer to a proper release. Either way, expect another update batch in the coming months!

We hope you enjoy all the new content and improvements, don't forget to discuss and send us your feedback at the official Phantasmata discord:
https://discord.gg/nEcRWEQ

notes.title: Phantasmata Silver Update
notes.content:
Hey deep dreamers, 
The city of Phantasmata is proud to announce some new big changes before going gold:

Combat system overhaul:
- Tmed hits system ( with multiple mechanics for different skills )
- Smaller damage/health values/digits (most combatants won't be over 100HP)
- Combat balancing 
- combatant order cycling

Updated main quest content:
- Updated story dialogue
- added riot chapter
- fixed later chapter discrepancies
- beefed up story told through NPCs and environments

New areas:
- Fixed Forest area
- Added desert border area
- Updated subway to hell areas
- Added riot area
- Added new areas in the hell chapter

GFX:
-Implemented new animated battleback effect
-Added location-based battlebacks 
-Added and updated new character dialogue busts
-Added new sprites for some denizens/citizens
-finished animating most character sprites

Music:
Randomized battle music ( battle BGM will be randomized from a playlist of currently 3 battle songs, more to be added ) 
Added music by Klava


[b]All of these changes will be implemented in the next build, estimated to be uploaded to steam the first week of December.[/b]

Thank you for your continuing love and support<3
-Xenon
